title: AION 2 Beginner Guide: First Session and Key Mistakes
description: A short first-session checklist, essential resource mistakes and where to go after level 45.
summary: A short first-session checklist, essential resource mistakes and where to go after level 45.
quickAnswer: Install the Steam main game, match region/faction/server with friends, set targeting and buffs, then follow Journal → Episode. Fill Ascension gates with regional quests or sealed dungeons. At 45, switch to the equipment route and Duty checklist.
